title: campanula rotundifolia var. tenuifolia
intro: Campanula rotundifolia var. tenuifolia, commonly known as the bellflower or Scottish gentian, is a plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. The plant is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally employed to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and fever reduction, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rotundifolia var. tenuifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
